column3: Most of you said: put him outside.
You roll up the loading door. He doesn't fight you. He just won't let go of that bag.
The door comes down. Nobody says anything for a long time.
Day two. Three in the morning. The music starts to stutter.
Generator's almost dry. When it dies, the music dies.
Evacuation at Hollis Stadium. Day three, six A.M. First fifty people only.
Fifty seats. I was going to tell you. Eventually.
At sunrise, you see it. The bag, lying under the delivery van.
You crawl out. The one by the van is Doctor Hale. And on the frozen ground, he can barely move.
Antidote samples. Keep cold. We threw out the guy who made the cure.
And as the sun comes up... they start moving faster.
The van is thirty meters away. The stadium is ten miles.
Do you run for the van now, or wait for the cold of night, when the music dies?
